title: Holding Several Ridgeline Installation Services Contracts: Program and Job Address Rule
content:
A customer of Ridgeline Installation Services may hold any number of installation contracts, across programs and across job addresses; there is no limit on the number of contracts one customer holds.

## The rule

A customer may not book a measure for a program at a job address while another contract for the same program at the same job address is open in status measure booked, measured, contracted, scheduled, in progress or completed. A cancelled or closed contract never blocks a new booking, and a customer whose quote expired books a new measure.

The test is made on the company's contract records, not on the customer's description: the customer, the program and the job address of the new booking are compared with the customer's existing contracts, and only a contract matching on all three, in one of the six open statuses, stands in the way.

## Booking test (input, judgement, result)

| Existing contract of the same customer | New measure booking | Booking allowed |
|---|---|---|
| Same program, same job address, status scheduled | same program, same address | no |
| Same program, same job address, status completed | same program, same address | no |
| Same program, same job address, status cancelled | same program, same address | yes |
| Same program, same job address, status closed | same program, same address | yes |
| Same program, different job address, any status | same program, new address | yes |
| Different program, same job address, any status | new program, same address | yes |

## Basis questions answered

**May a customer hold a carpet contract and a window and door contract for the same house?** Yes. Ridgeline Carpet Installation and Ridgeline Window and Door Installation are different programs, so neither contract blocks the other.

**A quote has expired and the contract was cancelled by the system. May the customer book again for the same program and address?** Yes. A cancelled contract never blocks a booking, and a customer whose quote expired books a new measure.
